name: Menu
summary: A list of selectable options — a side nav, an app-shell nav rail, a settings list, an overflow menu — with icons, groups, submenus, badges and danger actions.
highlights: For side navs, nav rails, settings lists and overflow menus
Icons, groups, submenus, badges and danger actions
A Discourse sidebar takes the nav rail look from discourse-sidebar.css
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-menu> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Feed it an `items` tree and a `value` (the selected key). The DS V3 Menu is a family, not a flat list: rows carry leading icons, a group title splits sections, a divider rules them off, a submenu expands inline, an item can be disabled or a red danger action, and a leaf can carry a `description` — a smaller muted second line under the label, for a role picker or a setting that needs one line of explanation, and a `shortcut`: the action's key drawn as the shared DS shortcut chip at the row's trailing edge on the label line (⌘D on a Mac, Ctrl D elsewhere), for a context menu. Each row can also carry a `testid` (rendered as `data-testid`), an `attrs` map that passes `data-*` and `aria-label` through to the row, and a `slot` name that projects rich light-DOM content (text with a tag, say) in place of the label. A leaf's `badge` names a light-DOM child (an `<aha-badge>`) projected at the row's trailing edge, for a count or a New marker. The `nav-rail` attribute is the app-shell side nav: no frame, and group titles become sentence-case section headers at 14px SemiBold 600. A third-party host whose markup the DS cannot own (a Discourse forum sidebar) takes the same look from `lib/discourse-sidebar.css`, a stylesheet on the --aha-* tokens. Three `mode`s: `vertical` (compact popover list, default), `inline` (indented sidebar tree), `horizontal` (top nav bar). The selected row is brand-tinted; hover, selection, submenu expand and the caret all animate via the shared motion tokens on PERSISTENT nodes — a class toggles, the subtree is never rebuilt on a state change. Emits a composed `select`.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin wrapper that listens for `select`; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Container
spec.value: white surface, 1px border #E3E3E3, radius 8, 6 padding, min-width 200

spec.label: Row
spec.value: height 36 · radius 8 · Regular 400, the selected row SemiBold 600 · 10px gap to a 16px leading icon

spec.label: Nav rail
spec.value: `nav-rail`: the app-shell side nav. No frame (the shell column frames it). Group titles are section headers: sentence case, 14px / 20px SemiBold 600, text-tertiary #616161, no uppercase or letter-spacing, 16px above (4px above the first) and 4px below. Rows, icons, hover and the selected row are the Menu's own: 36 high, 16px icon in the row ink, bg-hover #F7F7F7 on hover, bg-accent #E70E680D with SemiBold ink when selected

spec.label: Badge
spec.value: optional `badge` on a leaf: the slot name of a light-DOM child (an <aha-badge>: a black count, a dot or a New badge) drawn at the row's trailing edge, before a shortcut chip; part=badge; rows without one are unchanged

spec.label: Description
spec.value: optional second line, 6px below the label: size-sm 12px / 16px line, Regular 400, text-secondary #4A4A4A (text-disabled on a disabled row), wraps onto as many lines as it needs, never truncated; the row grows to fit (min-height 36, 6px vertical padding); part=description

spec.label: Shortcut
spec.value: optional `shortcut` on a leaf ("Mod+D", "Del", "Shift+Enter"): the shared DS shortcut chip (lib/shortcut-key.js, as Button and Tooltip draw it: 24px high, radius-xs 4, 6px side padding, a single key a 24 × 24 square, 14px Regular 400; in a menu row its background is gray-35 #EBEBEB, lighter than the Button and Tooltip 16% currentColor wash, so it stays readable on the bg-hover #F7F7F7 row; ⌘D on a Mac, Ctrl D elsewhere) pinned to the row's trailing edge on the label line, also when the row has a description; text-secondary #4A4A4A, text-disabled #B5B5B5 on a disabled row, the row colour on a danger row; display only and aria-hidden, the row carries aria-keyshortcuts ("Meta+D" on a Mac, "Control+D" elsewhere); part=shortcut; the row keeps its 36 height

spec.label: Submenu
spec.value: caret rotates 90° + children expand inline (motion-mid), aria-expanded synced

spec.label: Danger
spec.value: color-error text (default ink #1A1A1A: the colour rules give status no hue), error-tinted hover; a disabled danger row takes the disabled colour like any disabled row

spec.label: Disabled
spec.value: text-disabled #B5B5B5, not-allowed, no hover; disabled + aria-disabled, never focused or activated, skipped by the arrow keys

spec.label: Rich row
spec.value: `slot` replaces the label with the named light-DOM child (the label is the fallback); the row grows to fit (min-height 36, 6px vertical padding); part=rich; text, tags and icons only, never a nested button or link

spec.label: Row attributes
spec.value: `testid` → data-testid; `attrs` passes data-* (not data-key) and aria-label; any other name is dropped

spec.label: Discourse sidebar
spec.value: lib/discourse-sidebar.css restyles Discourse's core sidebar (#d-sidebar and the mobile hamburger panel) to the nav rail values: .sidebar-section-header-text → section header, .sidebar-section-link → row (.active → selected), .sidebar-section-link-prefix → 16px icon in the row ink (the inline category colour is overridden), .sidebar-section-link-content-badge → black count bubble 18 high, .sidebar-section-link-suffix → 6px ink dot, no rule between sections. Load tokens.css first

props.name: items
props.desc: Rows. Leaf {key,label,description?,shortcut?,icon?,disabled?,danger?,testid?,attrs?,slot?,badge?}; submenu {key,label,icon?,children:[],testid?,attrs?,slot?}; section {type:'group',label,children:[]}; rule {type:'divider'}. `shortcut` draws the key as the DS shortcut chip on the row's trailing edge (display only; the row gets aria-keyshortcuts); `testid` is rendered as data-testid; `attrs` passes data-* and aria-label to the row; `slot` projects the light-DOM child with that slot name in place of the label; `badge` projects the light-DOM child with that slot name at the row's trailing edge

props.name: mode
props.desc: Layout: compact list · indented sidebar tree · top nav bar

props.name: borderless
props.desc: Drop the container's border, radius, fill and padding, for a side nav inside a surface that already frames it (a settings modal's left column). Rows, group titles and dividers are unchanged

props.name: nav-rail
props.desc: The app-shell side nav: no frame, and group titles become sentence-case section headers (14px SemiBold 600). Use with mode="inline"

props.name: slot="<name>"
props.desc: Rich content for the row whose `slot` field matches: text, an <aha-tag>, an <aha-icon>. Never a button or link (the row is a button)

props.name: slot="<badge name>"
props.desc: An <aha-badge> for the row whose `badge` field matches, drawn at the row's trailing edge

props.name: select
props.desc: Composed event on selection, detail { key }

whenToUse.when: a list of destinations or options — a side nav, a settings list, an overflow list
the app-shell side nav (a forum, a hub, the dashboard rail); on a Discourse forum, discourse-sidebar.css
switching horizontal views within one screen
the same list should sit inside a triggered overlay, not inline

opinion.note: One selection at a time — reserve the brand tint for the active row. Keep labels short and in sentence case. Group related rows under a title: the title and its top spacing separate the sections, so a side nav needs no divider between groups. Rule off a destructive action with a divider and mark it danger. In a context menu, give a row a `shortcut` only when that key really runs the action in the app: the chip shows the key, it binds nothing. A side nav inside a framed surface (a settings modal) takes `borderless` so it carries no second box. For a triggered overlay, put a Menu inside a Dropdown rather than reinventing the list. An app's own side nav is `mode="inline" nav-rail`: sentence-case section headers, no dividers, one selected row, and a count or New marker in a row's `badge` slot. On a Discourse forum, where core renders the sidebar, load discourse-sidebar.css after tokens.css rather than rebuilding the rows.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 Menu component-set taxonomy: Menu / Submenu/Inline, Menu Item / Inline / Group Title, / Inline / Navigation Item, / Horizontal menu, / Sidebar menu / Highest level, / Vertical / Popover Menu — i.e. the family carries modes (horizontal · inline/sidebar · vertical popover), group titles, submenus, navigation items, disabled + danger rows. Token layer: white surface, border #E3E3E3, bg-accent selected fill, color-primary label, color-error danger, text-tertiary group title, radius-default 8. Motion bound to the shared motion tokens on persistent nodes.
